Ensure services meet or exceed defined SLAs, SLOs, availability targets, and customer expectations. Lead operational governance reviews and service performance reporting with senior leadership. Monitor service health, capacity, utilization, and operational risks across cloud environments. Establish and maintain operational runbooks, service documentation, and support processes. Operational Excellence Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on stability, automation, resiliency, and operational efficiency. Lead root cause analysis efforts and ensure corrective actions are implemented for major incidents. Develop and track key operational metrics and KPIs. Champion Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and DevOps practices to improve platform reliability. Identify opportunities to reduce technical debt and improve service quality. Incident, Problem & Change Management Serve as the escalation point for major incidents and service disruptions. Coordinate cross-functional teams during critical issue resolution activities. Lead problem management processes to identify recurring issues and implement permanent fixes. Ensure effective change management practices minimize operational risk and service disruption. Facilitate post-incident reviews and executive communications. Stakeholder & Relationship Management Act as the primary interface between Cloud Operations and internal business stakeholders. Build strong partnerships with Engineering, Security, Architecture, Risk, Compliance, and Application teams. Present service performance, risk assessments, and improvement plans to executive leadership. Manage stakeholder expectations and ensure alignment between service delivery and business objectives. Cloud Governance & Compliance Ensure cloud services operate in accordance with enterprise governance, security, compliance, and regulatory requirements. Support audit activities and risk management initiatives. Monitor operational controls and remediation activities. Drive adherence to cloud operational standards, policies, and best practices. Financial & Vendor Management Partner with cloud engineering and finance teams to optimize cloud operating costs. Monitor cloud consumption trends and support chargeback/showback initiatives. Manage relationships with cloud service providers and strategic vendors. Participate in contract reviews, service evaluations, and vendor performance assessments. Team Leadership Lead and mentor cloud operations personnel and service management teams. Foster a customer-centric culture focused on accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Support workforce planning, talent development, and succession planning. Promote automation-first and cloud-native operational practices. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. 8+ years of experience in IT Operations, Infrastructure Services, Cloud Operations, or Service Delivery. 3+ years of leadership experience managing cloud operations, service delivery, or infrastructure teams. Strong knowledge of public cloud platforms including Microsoft Azure, AWS, and/or Google Cloud Platform. Experience managing enterprise-scale cloud environments in highly regulated organizations. Deep understanding of ITIL service management principles and operational processes. Experience with incident, problem, change, and release management. Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, networking, security, resiliency, and disaster recovery. Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams during major incidents and operational events. Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and executive presentation skills. Preferred Qualifications ITIL Foundation or ITIL Managing Professional Certification. Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud certifications. Experience with SRE, DevOps, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), and automation platforms. Experience supporting financial services, healthcare, or other regulated industries. Familiarity with observability platforms such as Datadog, Splunk, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, or Azure Monitor. Knowledge of cloud financial management (FinOps) principles. Salary Range $137,400 - 233,600 USD Salary range is a good faith estimate of base pay. Northern Trust also provides a discretionary bonus program that may include an equity component. Work Authorization Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future. Northern Trust will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work visa status for this opportunity (no sponsorship is available for H-1B, L-1, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, F-1, J-1, OPT, CPT or any other employment-based visa). Working with Us As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve. Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities. Reasonable Accommodation Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
